discovery.aboutTitle: Good software starts with understanding people.
discovery.aboutLead: Four years building software. Three at Coco Tecnologías. A background that connects product development with the people who use it.
discovery.aboutPrompt: Follow the story, then explore the work that brings it to life.

chapters.label: 01 / BUILD
chapters.title: From a requirement to a working product.
chapters.text: Healthcare interfaces, diagnostic multi-scheduling and surgery scheduling. My work combines frontend and backend development, debugging and improvements to existing software.
chapters.detail: I translate business and user needs into technical solutions, implement interfaces, resolve application issues and collaborate on software improvements. The focus is on helping users complete their work clearly.

chapters.label: 02 / LISTEN
chapters.title: The person using it is part of the solution.
chapters.company: User support · Customer communication · Remote collaboration
chapters.text: At Coco, I worked directly with users and support tickets. Before that, customer-facing roles at Carulla and Teleperformance strengthened how I communicate and solve problems.
chapters.detail: One year at Carulla, six months supporting the North American Amazon line at Teleperformance, and virtual assistance for a real estate professional. That experience includes chats, emails, appointments and explaining solutions to non-technical people.

chapters.label: 03 / CONNECT
chapters.title: Make technology useful in everyday work.
chapters.company: AI implementation · Workflow design · API integrations
chapters.text: I combine software development with AI-assisted workflows to investigate problems, build, debug, document and improve practical business processes.
chapters.detail: My workflows include Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini and Grok, as well as AI connectors and tools such as Higgsfield, Canva, v0, Google Calendar and email. I review and test what ships.
